fields.name: merchant_api_key
fields.help: Peecho Merchant API key (dashboard > Settings > API), sent as the merchantApiKey query parameter and inside order/quote bodies. Test-environment keys belong to https://test.www.peecho.com/rest/v3/, which this server does not switch to.

config_fields.name: currency
config_fields.help: Currency for create_order (required by Peecho, e.g. EUR or USD) and quote_shipping prices (EUR when unset).

me.note: No account endpoint; the probe lists the offerings active on the account (grouped by category and sub-category codes).

quote_shipping.note: POST /rest/v3/quote for one offering (product_id = offeringId from Settings > Products) shipped to `country` (ISO-2): quotedItems[{productPrice, shippingWholesale, totalItemPrice, vat}] with quoteDetails and quoteSummary{totalWholesalePrice, totalShippingPrice} in `raw`. numberOfPages is not sent, so Peecho quotes the product's minimum page count; the default STANDARD shipping option is used.

create_order.note: Creates an OPEN (unpaid) order: nothing is produced or charged until the order is paid with POST /order/payment, which this server does not call. `items` are Peecho item_details [{offering_id, quantity, item_reference, file_details{content_url, content_width, content_height, number_of_pages}}]; `shipping_address` is Peecho's address_details {email_address, shipping_address{first_name, last_name, address_line_1, address_line_2, zip_code, city, state, country_code (ISO-2)}}; `shipping_option` is STANDARD or EXPEDITED. The currency setting is required by Peecho. Answers 201 {order_id}.

get_order.note: GET /rest/v3/order/details?orderId=: {order_id, order_state (OPEN, PAID, PAYMENT_ERROR, IN_PRINT_QUEUE, SHIPPED, ...), created_date, currency, tracking_code, tracking_url, order_price_data (decimal strings, so the wholesale total is returned as wholesale_total_inc_taxes), item_price_data, address_details, fulfilment_location}.

not_offered.list_products: GET /offering/list answers offerings nested under category and sub-category code keys ({"BO": {"SC": [...]}}) rather than one list, so rows cannot be addressed by a fixed path.
not_offered.get_product: No single-offering endpoint; offerings are only listed per category (GET /offering/list).
not_offered.track: No tracking-events endpoint; the order carries tracking_code and tracking_url once shipped (see get_order).

evidence: probe: 2/4 tools answered on their documented path with an auth refusal, a validation error or data; control route -> 404 (not_found), so the answers are path-specific
